sources.primary_title: MOZN at LEAP 2026: Bringing Enterprise AI Into Real-World Operations
sources.verified_angle_summary: At LEAP 2026, MOZN is pivoting from its previous focus on specific fraud products to a comprehensive enterprise AI platform strategy, supported by a recent strategic investment from HUMAIN. The newly announced MOZN AI Platform features six defined solution areas, including Fraud & Investigation Intelligence and Procurement & Supply Chain Intelligence. This shift emphasizes "Forward-Deployed Engineering" and "Sovereign AI," aiming to transition organizations from isolated AI experiments to secure, scalable production environments. Co-Founder Malik Alyousef will detail this transition during his session on the AI Leaders Stage. This angle provides a concrete, strategic corporate development story distinct from generic sovereign AI discussions or broad event previews.
sources.verified_key_facts: MOZN is a Platinum Sponsor at LEAP 2026 (Aug 31-Sep 3, 2026); The MOZN AI Platform features six enterprise AI solution areas; The platform is built on three pillars: Solutions for High-Assurance Domains, Sovereign AI, and Forward-Deployed Engineering; The announcement builds on a recent strategic investment in MOZN by HUMAIN; Malik Alyousef, Co-Founder and Deputy CEO of MOZN, will speak on the AI Leaders Stage on Sept 1; The six solution areas include Fraud & Investigation, Procurement & Supply Chain, Finance & Budget, Regulatory & Governance, Enterprise Knowledge, and Predictive Intelligence.
